thread:
maria.g: quick alert — noticed a spike of mTLS handshake failures from ap-south this morning after the RBAC change. ingress proxies returning 502/handshake_error. ops dashboard: https://dash/redwood/ingress/ap-south

akash.v: seeing KMS decrypt denies in the proxy logs around the same time. snippet:```2026-03-21T02:12:14Z proxy[ingress-3]: error: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for arn:aws:kms:ap-south:...:key/abcd - cert unwrap failed```

sec-bot: automated: cert-rotator job failed for ap-south on 2026-03-21T02:11:50Z — reason: unable to unwrap private key (KMS). job id: rot-20260321-44

ivan.k: did we change the keystore role policy? PR #4572 removed broad kms:* and tightened to kms:GenerateDataKey only for rotator svc-account. proxy-keystore role may have lost Decrypt permission.

maria.g: yes, that was the intent to follow least-priv. looks like we tightened the proxy role accidentally as part of the global policy roll.

shay.l: reproducer command:```openssl s_client -connect proxy.ap-south.redwood.ai:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem -cert /tmp/client.crt -key /tmp/client.key``` error: 'SSL routines:tls_construct_server_certificate:certificate verify failed' — but ingress logs show 'handshake aborted: unknown ca' and earlier KMS unwrap fails.

akash.v: timeline looks like: RBAC policy applied 1759986000, then cert rotation ran 1759988000, then proxy started returning handshake errors 1759989000. KMS calls show AccessDenied.

maria.g: rollback options: 1) re-grant kms:Decrypt to proxy-keystore for ap-south with condition on resource OR 2) patch rotator to perform key unwrap on behalf of proxy and push certs (longer). I'd prefer short-lived grant + audit capture.

ivan.k: agree short-lived grant scoped to the ap-south key ARN and proxy service principal. Also add explicit Condition for aws:RequestFromVPC or source IPs if possible. I'll draft the policy.

maria.g: I'll open emergency infra change and run a cert push + smoke tests. assigning to @ivan.k and @shay.l for verification. ETA 20m.

sec-bot: audit entry found: policy-change by jenkins-ci at 1759985905 — details: patch policies/global-keystore-role -> removed kms:Decrypt for role 'proxy-keystore'. link: https://audit/redwood/logs/1759985905

shay.l: after applying temporary kms:Decrypt grant and re-running rotator, smoke test:```curl --http2 --cert /tmp/client.crt --key /tmp/client.key -v https://proxy.ap-south.redwood.ai/health``` now returns 200 and TLS handshake completes.

akash.v: verified TLS traces show full chain now; intermediate was being delivered by rotator after successful unwrap. Without unwrap the proxy presented partial chain -> clients rejected.

maria.g: action items: (1) Ivan to push scoped kms:Decrypt policy (temp) and add condition, (2) Shay to run cert push + smoke tests and post logs, (3) Akash to add a unit/regression test to detect KMS unwrap denies during role changes, (4) I will follow up with infra team to add pre-change check to catch cross-service keystore dependencies.

ivan.k: pushed policy change as emergency patch and limited to key arn:aws:kms:ap-south:1111:key/abcd with principal arn:aws:iam::1111:role/proxy-keystore. attaching change id infra-5789.

sec-bot: audit: policy-change recorded infra-5789 by ivan.k at 1759993200.

shay.l: post-patch logs:```2026-03-21T02:31:05Z rotator: unwrap success for cert id c-21, pushed full chain to proxy; 2026-03-21T02:31:07Z proxy: handshake complete for client x.y.z -> 200 OK```

akash.v: rolling back the temporary grant only after we deploy a proper fix (rotator identity separation or explicit keystore mapping). I'll raise a follow-up ticket in infra backlog.

maria.g: thanks — marking incident as mitigated. follow-up: add integration gating that simulates role policy tighten in staging to catch this. will sync with sec and infra next week. :thumbsup:
